name: How do I know if my attic insulation needs to be replaced or added to?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my attic insulation needs to be replaced or added to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your attic insulation may need attention. If you notice uneven temperatures between rooms, high energy bills, or a constantly running HVAC system, your insulation might be insufficient. Drafts, especially near ceilings, and ice dams forming on your roof in winter are also indicators. A visual inspection can help; if the insulation is below or even with the top of your floor joists, or if it appears damp, moldy, or compacted, it's likely time for an upgrade. A professional assessment can determine the exact R-value and condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for uneven room temperatures, high energy bills, drafts, or visible deterioration like compaction or mold in your attic insulation.
